classification: Retrospective byte coverage and source interpretation; snapshots were already explored.
tools: Unmodified original ESP-IDF 5.4.1 partition and NVS tools
Offline GDB/objdump against matching original ELF
Retained private byte-comparison and raw-record review invocations
scope_limits: No new physical access; saved snapshots do not attest live board state.
Every gap outside the known artifacts and NVS is FF; compiled contents and NVS retain semantic/provenance limits.
Child blob payload slots are not independent named keys; recognized historical heads were inspected but not reconstructed as live values.
Null original ELF store callbacks and generated-key branches are source/binary facts; volatile key values, random-generation success and pairing history were not measured.
Snapshot/NVS digests, addresses, binaries and complete raw tool output remain private.
